sloka: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च ।। ६.५९.११५ ।।।।
transliteration: tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।jānubhyāmapatadbhūmau cacāla ca papāta ca ।। 6.59.115 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the son of the wind god, enraged, came towards Ravana. Full of anger, he struck him with his thunderbolt like fist on the chest of Ravana.
